items.title: Split-Level Porcelain Terrace with Brick Retaining Walls
items.summary: A dropped, crumbling brick garden rebuilt as a split-level porcelain terrace with brick retaining walls and full-width steps.
items.details: The original garden sat below the house on failing brickwork and loose rubble. We took the whole level out, rebuilt the retaining walls in matching brick, formed a generous flight of steps and finished both levels in light porcelain with tight, consistent joints. The low wall doubles as informal seating along the planted edge.
highlights: Brick retaining walls rebuilt from scratch
Full-width porcelain steps between levels
Two usable terraces from one unusable slope
Tight, consistent jointing throughout

items.title: Cream Porcelain Courtyard and Steps
items.summary: A dark, dated courtyard relaid in cream porcelain with new steps up to the house.
items.details: Working in a tight courtyard with no machine access, every slab and barrow-load was moved by hand. The old mixed surfaces came out, levels and falls were reset away from the building, and the new paving was laid to meet the existing brick steps cleanly.
highlights: Hand-dug in a no-access courtyard
Falls reset away from the house
Cream porcelain laid to the existing steps
Sharp cuts around walls and thresholds

items.title: Victorian Front Garden: Brick Wall and Geometric Tiled Path
items.summary: A Victorian frontage restored with a rebuilt brick garden wall, rendered steps and a black and white geometric tiled path.
items.details: The frontage had lost its original character to worn slabs and a failed boundary. We rebuilt the garden wall in matching stock brick with piers and copings, formed new steps to the front door, and laid a traditional black and white geometric tile path with a border to suit the period of the house.
highlights: Stock brick wall with piers and copings
Geometric tiled path in a period pattern
New steps and thresholds to the front door
Side path relaid to match

items.title: London Courtyard: Hardwood Deck and Slate Paving
items.summary: An overgrown, waterlogged town courtyard rebuilt with a hardwood deck and slate paving.
items.details: Years of leaf litter and a rotten deck had made the courtyard unusable. We cleared and levelled the whole space, built a new deck frame off the house, and laid dark slate paving to the remainder so the two surfaces meet flush. The result is a low-maintenance outdoor room for a garden that gets very little sun.
highlights: Rotten deck stripped and rebuilt
Slate paving laid flush to the deck
Whole courtyard cleared and re-levelled
Chosen for a shaded, low-light garden

items.title: Broken Crazy Paving Replaced with Silver Sandstone
items.summary: Failing crazy paving lifted and replaced with a silver-grey sandstone patio across the full rear of the house.
items.details: The old surface had broken up and was holding water against the building. We machine-excavated the area, laid a proper sub-base with falls away from the house, and paved in silver-grey sandstone with a clean edge against the planted border.
highlights: Machine excavation and full sub-base
Falls set away from the building
Silver-grey sandstone with a crisp border edge
Existing planting retained and worked around

items.title: Artificial Lawn and Porcelain Path in a Small Rear Garden
items.summary: A muddy winter garden turned into a year-round usable space with artificial grass and a porcelain path.
items.details: The garden was unusable for most of the year. We dug out, laid a permeable base, installed artificial turf and ran a light porcelain path from the back door to the shed and bin store so the garden works in all weather.
highlights: Permeable base under the artificial turf
Porcelain path to the shed and bin store
Usable in winter as well as summer
Clean edge detail between turf and paving

items.title: Railway Sleeper Raised Beds and Border Rebuild
items.summary: A collapsing border rebuilt as railway sleeper raised beds with fresh topsoil and planting depth.
items.details: The existing border had slumped and was losing soil onto the lawn. We stripped it back, built retaining beds from railway sleepers fixed to timber posts, and backfilled with quality topsoil to give proper root depth for shrubs and perennials.
highlights: Sleepers fixed to buried timber posts
Backfilled with quality topsoil
Generous depth for shrubs and perennials
Existing mature plants lifted and replanted

items.title: Brick Boundary Wall with Piers and Copings
items.summary: A new brick boundary wall with piers, copings and a planted bed behind.
items.details: Built in a yellow stock brick chosen to sit with the local housing, the wall is laid with regular piers, capped with copings and backed by a raised bed. It gives the frontage a defined edge without closing the garden in.
highlights: Yellow stock brick to suit the street
Regular piers with coping capping
Raised planted bed behind the wall
Defined frontage that keeps the light

items.title: Full-Width Sandstone Terrace for a Family House
items.summary: A full-width buff sandstone terrace wrapping the rear of a large family house.
items.details: Lawn ran straight up to the building with no usable seating area. We stripped and excavated the full width, built up the sub-base and laid buff Indian sandstone in a random-coursed pattern, returning it around the corner of the house and finishing with a straight edge against the reinstated lawn.
highlights: Random-coursed buff Indian sandstone
Terrace returns around the building
Full excavation and sub-base build-up
Lawn reinstated to a clean paving edge

items.title: Porcelain Stepping Stones Through a New Lawn
items.summary: A tired lawn replaced with fresh turf, a porcelain terrace and oversized stepping stones down the garden.
items.details: The brief was a clean, calm garden that still reads as mostly lawn. We laid a light porcelain terrace by the house, set large-format stepping stones flush into new turf so a mower can pass straight over them, and kept the planting to the boundaries.
highlights: Stepping stones set flush for mowing
Large-format porcelain terrace
New turf laid across the garden
Simple, uncluttered layout

items.title: Black and White Tiled Front Path with Brick Walls
items.summary: A worn front approach rebuilt with brick walls, a bin store recess and a black and white tiled path.
items.details: The frontage had no boundary and a failing concrete path. We built low brick walls with piers to define the garden and screen the bins, then laid a traditional black and white tiled path with a dark border, finished to the original front step.
highlights: Low brick walls with piers
Screened recess for bins
Black and white tile with dark border
Finished neatly to the original step

items.title: Rotten Deck Stripped Back and Rebuilt
items.summary: A rotten, uneven deck stripped back to nothing and rebuilt across the full width of the garden.
items.details: The original boards had failed and the frame underneath had gone with them. We took the lot out, built a new treated frame with proper joist spacing and ventilation, and laid new boards running the length of the garden to make the space feel longer.
highlights: Old frame and boards fully removed
New treated frame with correct joist centres
Boards run lengthways to lengthen the space
Ventilation designed into the structure

items.title: Corner Deck Built Off the Garden Doors
items.summary: A wraparound corner deck built off the garden doors of a rear extension.
items.details: The lawn met the extension at an awkward level. We built a low corner deck that steps down to the grass, sized so a table and chairs sit comfortably outside the doors without eating into the lawn.
highlights: Built to meet the door threshold level
Wraps the corner of the extension
Steps down cleanly to the lawn
Sized around outdoor dining

items.title: Cleared Courtyard Rebuilt in Riven Sandstone
items.summary: A courtyard full of rubble and broken slabs cleared and relaid in riven sandstone with sleeper beds.
items.details: Everything came out first — old paving, broken concrete and years of debris. We reset the levels, laid riven Indian sandstone in a mixed-size pattern and built sleeper beds along two boundaries to give the courtyard some planting and soften the fences.
highlights: Full clearance of rubble and old paving
Mixed-size riven sandstone pattern
Sleeper beds on two boundaries
Levels reset across the whole courtyard

items.title: Curved Garden Path with Brick Soldier Edging
items.summary: A curved garden path in grey paving with a brick soldier-course edge.
items.details: The path sweeps from the terrace down the garden, edged on both sides with a brick soldier course that holds the curve and restrains the paving. Cuts were set out so the curve reads smoothly rather than as a series of straight runs.
highlights: Brick soldier course to both edges
Curve set out before any cutting
Grey paving to match the terrace
Restrained edge that holds the line

items.title: Family Garden with Porcelain Terrace and Sleeper Beds
items.summary: A cluttered family garden reorganised around a porcelain terrace and sleeper-edged planting beds.
items.details: The garden had grown into a patchwork of borders, toys and worn grass with no clear seating area. We set out a proper terrace off the house in light porcelain, contained the planting in sleeper-edged beds and left a clear, usable lawn in between.
highlights: Clear terrace, bed and lawn zones
Sleeper-edged beds hold the planting
Light porcelain terrace off the house
Membrane and topsoil renewed in the beds

items.title: Overgrown Frontage Turned into a Walled Paved Garden
items.summary: A completely overgrown frontage cleared and rebuilt as a walled, paved garden.
items.details: The front garden had disappeared under self-seeded shrubs and a collapsing retaining edge. We cleared it entirely, rebuilt the retaining structure in brick, and paved the level area so it works as usable space rather than neglected planting.
highlights: Complete clearance of overgrown planting
Brick retaining rebuilt on the boundary
Level paved area created
Frontage made usable and maintainable

items.title: Rear Garden Rebuilt with Pergola, Porcelain and Sleeper Beds
items.summary: A plain rectangular garden rebuilt with a porcelain terrace, sleeper beds and a timber pergola.
items.details: We reset the whole garden: new paving across the terrace, sleeper-edged beds along the boundaries and a timber pergola over the seating area to give it some height and shelter. New fencing ties the boundaries together.
highlights: Timber pergola over the seating area
Sleeper-edged boundary beds
Porcelain terrace across the width
Boundaries refenced to match

items.title: Front Drive Frontage with New Brick Walls
items.summary: A frontage rebuilt with new brick walls and piers around a resurfaced drive.
items.details: The old boundary had failed and the drive edge was breaking up. We rebuilt the walls in brick with piers at the openings, set new edging to contain the surface, and resurfaced the drive to a clean line against the pavement.
highlights: Brick walls with piers at the entrance
New edge restraint to the drive
Resurfaced to a clean pavement line
Levels corrected across the frontage

items.title: Full Boundary Replaced with Closeboard Fencing
items.summary: A leaning, gappy boundary replaced with closeboard fencing on concrete posts and gravel boards.
items.details: The old fence had rotted at ground level and was leaning into the garden. We took out the full run, set concrete posts, fitted gravel boards to keep the timber off the soil and installed closeboard panels to a consistent height and line.
highlights: Concrete posts and gravel boards
Closeboard panels to a consistent line
Timber kept clear of ground contact
Old fence and waste removed

items.title: Multi-Tone Indian Sandstone Driveway and Frontage
items.summary: A multi-tone Indian sandstone driveway and frontage laid in a random pattern.
items.details: Laid in a random-coursed pattern across the full frontage, the sandstone runs from the pavement to the garage and door thresholds with a block edge restraint. The mixed tones were set out on the ground before laying so the colour spreads evenly across the drive.
highlights: Random-coursed multi-tone sandstone
Colour set out before laying
Block edge restraint throughout
Runs cleanly to garage and door thresholds

items.title: Communal Steps, Handrails and Block-Paved Approach
items.summary: Communal steps rebuilt with handrails and a block-paved approach for a residential block.
items.details: A wide public flight serving flats, rebuilt with consistent risers, new handrails to both sides and a block-paved landing and approach. The banks either side were regraded and prepared for planting.
highlights: Consistent riser heights across the flight
Handrails to both sides
Block-paved landing and approach
Banks regraded and prepared

items.title: Dropped Kerb and Block-Paved Parking
items.summary: A dropped kerb formed and a block-paved parking area laid to the frontage.
items.details: Kerbs were dropped and the crossing formed to give vehicle access, then the parking area was excavated, edged and block paved. The work was signed and coned throughout to keep the footway safe while it was open.
highlights: Dropped kerb and vehicle crossing formed
Block paving with edge restraint
Footway kept coned and safe
Levels tied into the existing pavement

items.title: Seasonal Lawn Care on a Large Country Garden
items.summary: Seasonal cutting, edging and striping on a large country lawn.
items.details: A regular maintenance visit on a big open lawn: cut to a consistent height, striped in clean lines, edges cut back to the borders and the terrace blown down and left clear.
highlights: Consistent cut height across the lawn
Striped in clean, straight lines
Edges cut back to the borders
Terrace blown down and left clear

items.title: Stripped Back to Sub-Base: Porcelain Terrace and Artificial Lawn
items.summary: A garden taken back to sub-base by machine and rebuilt with a porcelain terrace and artificial lawn.
items.details: The whole garden came out — turf, borders and old edging — under a mini digger. We rebuilt from the sub-base up with a light porcelain terrace across the width, an artificial lawn laid to a permeable base, and sleeper edging holding the two apart.
highlights: Machine strip-out to sub-base
Porcelain terrace across the full width
Artificial lawn on a permeable base
Sleeper edge between paving and turf

items.title: Tired Lawn Replaced with Artificial Grass and Porcelain
items.summary: A worn, patchy lawn replaced with artificial grass and a porcelain patio for a low-maintenance garden.
items.details: The grass had thinned to bare soil under mature trees and the old patio was breaking up. We removed both, laid a permeable base for artificial turf and paved a new seating area in porcelain with a timber edge between the two.
highlights: Works under mature trees where grass failed
Permeable base under the turf
Porcelain seating area off the house
Timber edge between turf and paving

items.title: Front Path, Steps and Railings in Silver Sandstone
items.summary: A gravel and weed frontage rebuilt with silver sandstone paving, new steps and reinstated railings.
items.details: The front garden was loose gravel and failing timber edging. We excavated, laid silver-grey sandstone across the whole frontage, formed new steps up to the front door and reinstated the railings and gate against the rebuilt brick.
highlights: Silver-grey sandstone across the frontage
New steps up to the front door
Railings and gate reinstated
Brick edge rebuilt to the boundary

items.title: Circular Feature Patio in a Large Country Garden
items.summary: A large country garden given a circular feature patio set into the lawn.
items.details: Cut into an open lawn and reached by a wide paved path, the circle is set out from a centre point with cut radial courses and a full border ring. Levels were worked so the mower can run straight over the edge.
highlights: Circle set out from a fixed centre point
Cut radial courses with a border ring
Wide paved path to the terrace
Mower-height edge into the lawn

items.title: Long Porcelain Path Beside a New Lawn
items.summary: A long porcelain path running the length of the garden beside a new lawn.
items.details: A single-width run of large-format porcelain set between the building and a new lawn, edged both sides and laid to fall away from the wall so water runs into the grass rather than back into the structure.
highlights: Large-format porcelain in a single run
Edged and restrained both sides
Falls set away from the building
New lawn laid to the paving edge

items.title: Charcoal Porcelain Terrace and New Boundary
items.summary: A derelict side garden cleared and rebuilt as a charcoal porcelain terrace behind a new timber boundary.
items.details: The area was rubble, self-seeded growth and a failed boundary. We cleared and disposed of the lot, laid a large-format charcoal porcelain terrace with a brick border and built a new slatted timber boundary along the open side.
highlights: Full clearance and waste removal
Large-format charcoal porcelain
Brick border to the paving edge
New slatted timber boundary

items.title: Overgrown Plot Turned into a Low-Maintenance Gravel Garden
items.summary: A garden lost to brambles turned into a low-maintenance gravel garden with a pergola and seating.
items.details: The plot was completely overgrown and hadn't been usable for years. We cleared it back to bare ground, laid membrane and decorative gravel either side of a dark paved path, and built a timber pergola over a seating area at the far end.
highlights: Cleared from fully overgrown
Membrane and decorative gravel
Dark paved path through the centre
Timber pergola over the seating area

items.title: Side Return Paved with Gravel Borders and Gate
items.summary: A side return paved with gravel margins, a new gate and a planted feature.
items.details: A narrow, awkward side return made usable: paving down the centre for access, gravel margins either side to take the run-off, a new post-set gate at the entrance and a small planted feature to break up the length.
highlights: Paved centre run with gravel margins
New gate on set posts
Run-off taken into the gravel
Planted feature to break the length

items.title: Raised Timber Deck with Wide Steps to the Lawn
items.summary: A raised timber deck with wide steps bridging the level change to the lawn.
items.details: Built off the back of the house on a treated frame and posts, the deck sits level with the internal floor and steps down in wide, shallow treads to the garden. The frame is set out to take furniture without bounce.
highlights: Deck set level with the internal floor
Wide, shallow steps down to the lawn
Treated frame on set posts
Joist centres sized for furniture loads

items.title: Old Concrete Base Replaced with a Porcelain Terrace
items.summary: A cracked concrete base lifted and replaced with a porcelain terrace to a garden room.
items.details: The old concrete slab had cracked and settled unevenly against the building. We broke it out, rebuilt the base with proper compaction and falls, and laid a light porcelain terrace running the full width of the glazing.
highlights: Old concrete slab broken out
Base rebuilt with proper compaction
Falls set away from the glazing
Terrace runs the full width of the doors

items.title: Indian Sandstone Patio with Planted Steps
items.summary: A bare, dug-over garden finished with an Indian sandstone patio and planted steps.
items.details: Laid across the rear of the house in mixed-size Indian sandstone with steps down to the garden and a raised planted bed built into the change of level. Railings were fitted alongside the steps.
highlights: Mixed-size Indian sandstone pattern
Steps built into the level change
Raised planted bed to the terrace edge
Railings fitted to the steps

items.title: Hot Tub Terrace with Sleeper Retaining and New Lawn
items.summary: A sloping lawn cut into a level porcelain terrace with sleeper retaining, a hot tub base and reinstated grass.
items.details: The garden fell away from the house, so the terrace had to be cut in and retained. We built sleeper retaining along the new edge, laid a light porcelain terrace sized to take a hot tub and seating, and reinstated the lawn below to a clean line.
highlights: Level terrace cut into a sloping garden
Sleeper retaining along the new edge
Base sized and built for a hot tub
Lawn reinstated to a clean paving edge

items.title: Deck Built Level with the Garden Doors
items.summary: A deck built level with the garden doors across the rear of the house.
items.details: Set out to meet the door threshold so there's no step out of the house, the deck runs the full width of the rear elevation with a low step down to the lawn and boards running parallel to the building.
highlights: Threshold-level with no step out
Runs the full width of the elevation
Single low step down to the lawn
Boards run parallel to the house

items.title: Artificial Lawn with Block Paved Edging
items.summary: A worn back garden cleared and laid with artificial grass inside a block paved edge.
items.details: The garden was bare earth and clutter. We cleared and disposed of it all, laid a permeable base and installed artificial turf held inside a charcoal block paved edge that also forms the path to the shed.
highlights: Full clearance and waste removal
Permeable base under the turf
Charcoal block paved edge restraint
Edge doubles as the path to the shed

items.title: Block Paved Terrace with Charcoal Border
items.summary: A worn slab patio and patchy grass replaced with a block paved terrace and charcoal border.
items.details: We took out the old slabs and levelled the area, then laid block paving in a mid-tone mix with a charcoal border and soldier course to define the edges. The paving runs to the doors so the terrace reads as one clean space.
highlights: Mid-tone blocks with a charcoal border
Soldier course defining the edges
Old slabs lifted and removed
Paving runs cleanly to the doors

items.title: Split-Level Patio, Deck and Brick Steps
items.summary: A dated split-level garden rebuilt with new paving, a timber deck and brick steps.
items.details: The original terrace, steps and retaining were all failing. We rebuilt the level change in brick with new steps, laid warm-toned paving on the upper terrace and built a timber deck at the lower level, tying the two together off the kitchen doors.
highlights: Level change rebuilt in brick
New steps between upper and lower levels
Warm-toned paving on the upper terrace
Timber deck at the lower level

items.title: Blue-Black Porcelain Forecourt and Parking
items.summary: A tired tarmac frontage relaid as a blue-black porcelain forecourt with block paved margins.
items.details: The frontage served several properties and had broken up along the kerb line. We excavated and rebuilt the base, laid large-format blue-black porcelain across the parking area and picked out the margins and kerb line in contrasting block paving.
highlights: Large-format blue-black porcelain
Base rebuilt for vehicle loading
Contrasting block paved margins
Kerb line reinstated to the road
